map.已用年限 =（今天 − 首次使用日期）÷ 365.25；剩余年限 = 参考安全年: Used years = (today − first-use date) ÷ 365.25; remaining years = reference safe life − used years; replacement date = first-use date + reference safe life; safety progress = used years ÷ reference safe life × 100%. Reference life follows common industry-standard and maker limits, not a mandatory scrap date.

Safe service life is not a mandatory scrap date; after it, check cords, plugs, internal wiring, grounding and residual-current protection. Stop and replace immediately if the cord hardens, the plug overheats, odor appears, the breaker trips, the shell feels live or a gas alarm sounds. Frequent use, humidity, grease and long full-load operation accelerate aging; follow the nameplate, manual and maker's advice.
map.超过安全使用年限就一定要换吗？: Must I replace an appliance once past its safe life?
map.不一定立即报废，但风险明显上升。应重点检查电源线、插头、内部接线、接地与漏电保护: Not necessarily scrap immediately, but risk rises. Check cords, plugs, internal wiring, grounding and residual-current protection; stop and replace if the cord hardens, the plug overheats, odor appears, the breaker trips or the shell feels live.
map.年限从购买日还是首次使用日算？: Should the life count from purchase or first use?
map.以首次通电使用日更接近实际；只有发票日期时用购买日估算并预留余量。长期闲置未通电: First powered use is closer to reality; if only the invoice date is known, use it and leave a margin. Insulation still ages while idle, but loaded life is longer.
map.安全使用年限和保修期是一回事吗？: Is safe service life the same as the warranty period?
map.不是。保修期是厂商免费维修承诺，通常 1–3 年；安全使用年限是行业标准给出的参: No. Warranty is a free-repair promise, usually 1–3 years; safe service life is a reference upper limit from industry standards, commonly 5–10 years. Past warranty does not mean replacement, and reaching the safe limit does not mean it is safe to keep pushing.
map.超期家电还能卖二手吗？: Can an appliance past its safe life be sold second-hand?
map.可以，但应如实告知年限与维修史，并确认电源线、插头、接地完好。燃气、承压或大功率: Yes, but disclose the age and repair history and confirm the cord, plug and grounding are intact. Past-limit gas, pressure or high-power appliances should go to formal recycling rather than to buyers unaware of the risk.
